notes.title: Hotfix - item respawns
notes.content:
Heya folks, ive adjusted some screen spaced effects that would have reduced some performance, I will be working on some various quality settings soon.

Important Interactable items will respawn back to where they were found after a short period of time, just in case you lose anything.

I'm going to be working on a backpack and possible inventory system next, although I'm not sure the odd key here and there is too important to be stored away.

also a rogue door underground in the basement is now fixed, (No you're not supposed to go through that one).

Cheers,

Graham

notes.title: Major Overhaul
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44047608/8f4699ce50bc5b69872a4039c345d4c3ddd3eacb.png
We've been very busy over the past few months giving the game a major renovation, bringing with it a host of new things based on feedback from those who previously played the game.

We felt the need to strip the game of any off the shelf packages where we could and work on revealing more of the story to you in a more direct way.

Things we have done are:

 Brand new interaction system
 Updated story
 Lighting and visual overhaul
 Graphics optimization
 General optimization
 More fully interactable environment and items
 Removal of gunfight elements to refocus story on the horror aspect
 New character
 New Audio Voice overs and Foley
 Animation update
 Swimming Mechanic
 Player Death Mechanic
 More furniture and areas in the manor to explore
 Breakable items
 Player arms 


We hope you enjoy the latest update and really immerse yourselves in White Willow Manor.

notes.title: Update 1.0 progress
notes.content:
Hiya folks,

The past couple of weeks have been really productive, we have been hard at work creating a new story arc, with the beginning scenes re-jigged and some really powerful new story.

We have had some real beef with the interaction system I used during the initial build of the game, with physics creating some issues with doors and the grabbing system, so Steve has been writing a new interaction system tailored to what it is exactly that Emiline needs, this will open up more possibilities and also allow players to explore the world much more intricately, opening furniture and moving things around; It will be a much smoother and higher polished experience.
We have also added a dynamic flak system and a more cinematic 1st person experience from the offset.

Along with these updates we are updating the audio system too

Along with the new save system recently added we will be able to expand on the original story and really bring to life the missing parts of the story, keeping players inside the manor house for longer, for many more thrills and chills.

Keep and eye out and we shall report back with more news as we move along.

Graham & Steve
